meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely home:* Newly Constructed Home - Floor to ceiling windows* 4 Included Bikes* Brand New Flooring, Furnishings, Appliances, and Décor* Private, Fenced in Back Yard and Covered Patio* Open Floor Plan w/ Large Windows* 1.2 Mi
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely home:* Newly Constructed Home - Floor to ceiling windows* 4 Included Bikes* Brand New Flooring, Furnishings, Appliances, and Décor* Private, Fenced in Back Yard and Covered Patio* Open Floor Plan w/ Large Windows* 1.2 Miles to West Allen Loop Beach Access* 2.1 Miles to Shunk Gully, Growlers, and Gulf Place Town Center* 2.6 Miles to Publix Super Market* Snorkel the Seahorse Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Come live your best life at Viva La Vida, and discover a vacation paradise. This newly constructed 3 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom home sits on a quiet street north of 30A and is conveniently located within driving distance of multiple restaurants. Step through the front door to be greeted by a large open floor plan with hardwood flooring and plenty of natural light from the large windows. Everything is new from the furniture to the décor, and the elegant stainless steel appliances in the kitchen. The master bedroom features a king bed, and ensuite bathroom, walk-in closet, and a private sliding glass door to the back yard. This home features a queen guest bedroom, and a second guest bedroom with 2 twin beds, and a sleeper sofa in the living room, allowing it to sleep 8 guests comfortably. For your entertainment needs each bedroom boasts its own Smart TV. Step out the sliding glass doors into the fenced in backyard, or ride the included bikes down to the beach, whatever you decide Viva La Vida will help you make long lasting memories.Bed Setup:Master bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: 2 twin beds (Sleeps 2)Living Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa AREA ATTRACTIONS: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The Gulf Place community is located along a 26-mile stretch of sugar-white sand and turquoise waters of Northwest Florida’s celebrated Emerald Coast. As one of the 16 distinct beach neighborhoods in South Walton, it has its own distinct character and charm. This colorful community on 30A is comprised of 25 acres located in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach on the corner of 30A and 393. Gulf Place was specifically designed to slow visitors and locals down with palm tree-lined streets, wide sidewalks, colorful outdoor patios with large umbrellas, nature walking trails, green spaces and ample park benches to sit and enjoy the views. Gulf Place is unique from all the other South Walton neighborhoods. Residents and guests gather here to enjoy original art, boutique shopping, local cuisine, live music and a laid back atmosphere.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
